suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
sw$genotype <- factor(sw$genotype, levels = c('Wildtype','ΔlasI','ΔlasR','ΔrhlI','rhlR-'))
sw$system <- factor(ifelse(sw$genotype == 'Wildtype', 'WT',
                     ifelse(sw$genotype %in% c('ΔlasI','ΔlasR'), 'las', 'rhl')),
                    levels = c('WT','las','rhl'))

print(sw %>% group_by(genotype, system) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            area_mean = mean(area), area_sd = sd(area), area_gm = exp(mean(log(area))),
            circ_mean = mean(circularity), circ_sd = sd(circularity), circ_gm = exp(mean(log(circularity))),
            round_mean = mean(roundness), round_sd = sd(roundness), .groups='drop'), width = Inf)

welch_vs_wt <- function(df, var, transform = identity) {
  wt <- transform(df[[var]][df$genotype == 'Wildtype'])
  muts <- setdiff(levels(df$genotype), 'Wildtype')
  res <- lapply(muts, function(g) {
    x <- transform(df[[var]][df$genotype == g])
    tt <- t.test(x, wt, var.equal = FALSE)
    data.frame(genotype = g, estimate = tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2],
               ci_low = tt$conf.int[1], ci_high = tt$conf.int[2],
               df = unname(tt$parameter), p_raw = tt$p.value)
  })
  do.call(rbind, res)
}

a_log <- welch_vs_wt(sw, 'area', log)
a_log$ratio <- exp(a_log$estimate); a_log$ratio_low <- exp(a_log$ci_low); a_log$ratio_high <- exp(a_log$ci_high)
a_log$p_holm <- p.adjust(a_log$p_raw, 'holm')

c_log <- welch_vs_wt(sw, 'circularity', log)
c_log$ratio <- exp(c_log$estimate); c_log$ratio_low <- exp(c_log$ci_low); c_log$ratio_high <- exp(c_log$ci_high)
c_log$p_holm <- p.adjust(c_log$p_raw, 'holm')

r_raw <- welch_vs_wt(sw, 'roundness', identity)
r_raw$p_holm <- p.adjust(r_raw$p_raw, 'holm')

cat('--- AREA (log scale: ratio of geometric means, Welch t) ---\n')
print(a_log, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
cat('\n--- CIRCULARITY (log scale: ratio of geometric means, Welch t) ---\n')
print(c_log, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
cat('\n--- ROUNDNESS (raw scale: mean difference, Welch t) ---\n')
print(r_raw, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)

cat('\n--- Alternative: pooled-variance t-tests, Holm ---\n')
for (v in c('area','circularity','roundness')) {
  tr <- if (v == 'roundness') identity else log
  wt <- tr(sw[[v]][sw$genotype == 'Wildtype'])
  ps <- sapply(setdiff(levels(sw$genotype), 'Wildtype'), function(g) {
    t.test(tr(sw[[v]][sw$genotype == g]), wt, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value })
  cat(v, ':', paste(sprintf('%s=%.4g', names(ps), p.adjust(ps, 'holm')), collapse = '  '), '\n')
}

cat('\n--- Alternative: exact Wilcoxon area, each mutant vs WT ---\n')
for (g in setdiff(levels(sw$genotype), 'Wildtype')) {
  w <- wilcox.test(sw$area[sw$genotype == g], sw$area[sw$genotype == 'Wildtype'], exact = TRUE)
  cat(g, ': p =', format(w$p.value), '\n')
}

cat('\n--- Secondary: las mutants vs rhl mutants, log area (Welch) ---\n')
las <- log(sw$area[sw$system == 'las']); rhl <- log(sw$area[sw$system == 'rhl'])
tt <- t.test(las, rhl, var.equal = FALSE)
cat(sprintf('ratio rhl/las = %.3f (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f), p = %.4g, df = %.1f\n',
            exp(tt$estimate[1]-tt$estimate[2]), exp(tt$conf.int[1]), exp(tt$conf.int[2]), tt$p.value, tt$parameter))
cat(sprintf('rhl vs las circularity ratio = %.3f, p = %.4g\n',
            exp(mean(log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='rhl'])) - mean(log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='las']))),
            t.test(log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='rhl']), log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='las']))$p.value))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)})
coc <- read.csv("data/swarming/cocultures.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
coc$culture <- factor(coc$culture, levels = c("wild type", "ΔlasI", "ΔrhlI", "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI"))
mix <- subset(coc, culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI")
mix$ratio <- as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)) /
             as.numeric(sub(".*:", "", mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI))
cat("rows:", nrow(coc), " conditions:", length(unique(coc$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)), "\n")
print(coc %>% group_by(culture, ratio_rhlI_to_lasI) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), area_gm = round(exp(mean(log(area)))), area_mean = round(mean(area)),
            area_sd = round(sd(area)), circ_mean = round(mean(circularity), 3),
            round_mean = round(mean(roundness), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\npackages:", paste(c("dplyr","ggplot2","patchwork","car","boot") %in% rownames(installed.packages()), collapse = " "), "\n")
cat("ratio values in mix:", paste(sort(unique(mix$ratio)), collapse = " "), "\n")

# Compare each mix ratio with wild type and fit the ratio response
wt_area <- coc$area[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_circ <- coc$circularity[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_round <- coc$roundness[coc$culture == "wild type"]

cmp <- mix %>% group_by(ratio) %>% group_modify(~{
  tt <- t.test(log(.x$area), log(wt_area))
  tc <- t.test(log(.x$circularity), log(wt_circ))
  data.frame(n = nrow(.x),
             area_ratio = exp(unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2])),
             area_lo = exp(tt$conf.int[1]), area_hi = exp(tt$conf.int[2]),
             area_p = tt$p.value,
             circ_ratio = exp(unname(tc$estimate[1] - tc$estimate[2])),
             circ_p = tc$p.value)
}) %>% ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
cmp$area_p_holm <- p.adjust(cmp$area_p, "holm")
cmp$circ_p_holm <- p.adjust(cmp$circ_p, "holm")
print(transform(cmp, area_ratio = round(area_ratio,3), area_lo = round(area_lo,2),
                area_hi = round(area_hi,2), area_p_holm = signif(area_p_holm,3),
                circ_ratio = round(circ_ratio,3), circ_p_holm = signif(circ_p_holm,3))[, -c(6,8)],
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

# Quadratic model in log2 ratio, rescue window 1:3 to 100:1
win <- subset(mix, ratio >= 1/3 & ratio <= 100)
win$x <- log2(win$ratio)
m1 <- lm(log(area) ~ x, data = win)
m2 <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win)
cat("\nwindow n =", nrow(win), " ratios:", length(unique(win$ratio)), "\n")
cat("linear R2:", round(summary(m1)$r.squared, 4), " quadratic R2:", round(summary(m2)$r.squared, 4), "\n")
cat("quadratic term p:", signif(anova(m1, m2)$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3), "\n")
cf <- coef(m2)
peak_log2 <- -cf[2]/(2*cf[3]); peak <- 2^peak_log2
cat("peak ratio:", round(peak, 2), ":1   peak log2:", round(peak_log2, 3), "\n")
cat("coefficients:", paste(round(cf, 4), collapse = "  "), "\n")

# cluster bootstrap of the peak (resample dishes within ratio)
set.seed(1)
B <- 5000
boot_peak <- replicate(B, {
  idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(win)), win$ratio), function(i) sample(i, length(i), replace = TRUE)))
  cf <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win[idx, ]))
  if (is.na(cf[3]) || cf[3] >= 0) NA_real_ else 2^(-cf[2]/(2*cf[3]))
})
cat("bootstrap peak median and 95% CI:", paste(round(quantile(boot_peak, c(.5,.025,.975), na.rm=TRUE), 2), collapse = "  "),
    "  (non-peak fits:", sum(is.na(boot_peak)), "of", B, ")\n")

# Same fit including the extreme 500:1 and 1000:1 ratios
mix$x <- log2(mix$ratio)
m2_all <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = mix)
cf_all <- coef(m2_all)
cat("all-ratio fit R2:", round(summary(m2_all)$r.squared, 4), " peak:", round(2^(-cf_all[2]/(2*cf_all[3])), 2), "\n")

# One-way ANOVA among mix ratios (ratio effect size)
for (d in list(win = win, all = mix)) {
  a <- aov(log(area) ~ factor(ratio), data = d)
  s <- summary(a)$`Sum Sq`
  cat("ANOVA", if (nrow(d) == 30) "window" else "all", "R2 =", round(s[1]/sum(s), 4), "\n")
}

# Fitted values at window ends and peak, versus WT
cat("\nfitted gm at 1:3:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(1/3)))), 0),
    " at peak:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = peak_log2))), 0),
    " at 100:1:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(100)))), 0),
    " | WT gm:", round(exp(mean(log(wt_area))), 0), "\n")

# Effect sizes, shape model and rescue window
eta2 <- function(d) { a <- aov(log(area) ~ factor(ratio), data = d); s <- summary(a)[[1]][["Sum Sq"]]; s[1]/sum(s) }
cat("one-way R2 among mix ratios, window:", round(eta2(win), 4),
    " all 12 ratios:", round(eta2(mix), 4), "\n")
cat("quadratic model residual SD (log scale):", round(summary(m2)$sigma, 4),
    " df:", summary(m2)$df[2], "\n")
m3 <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3), data = win)
cat("cubic term p:", signif(anova(m2, m3)$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3), " cubic R2:", round(summary(m3)$r.squared, 4), "\n")

# Circularity on log scale, same window (minimum = smoothest colonies)
cm2 <- lm(log(circularity) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win)
ccf <- coef(cm2)
cat("circularity quadratic R2:", round(summary(cm2)$r.squared, 4),
    " minimum at ratio:", round(2^(-ccf[2]/(2*ccf[3])), 2),
    " fitted min:", round(exp(predict(cm2, newdata = data.frame(x = -ccf[2]/(2*ccf[3])))), 3),
    " | WT:", round(exp(mean(log(wt_circ))), 3), "\n")

# Observed peak mix (10:1) against each single mutant and wild type
p10 <- subset(mix, ratio == 10)
for (grp in c("ΔrhlI", "ΔlasI", "wild type")) {
  ref <- coc$area[coc$culture == grp]
  tt <- t.test(log(p10$area), log(ref))
  cat("10:1 vs", grp, ": ratio", round(exp(unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2])), 2),
      " CI", paste(round(exp(tt$conf.int), 2), collapse = "-"), " p", signif(tt$p.value, 3), "\n")
}

# Rescue window: where the fitted curve is at or above the wild-type geometric mean
lv <- log(exp(mean(log(wt_area))))
cf <- coef(m2)
roots <- polyroot(c(cf[1] - lv, cf[2], cf[3]))
roots <- Re(roots[abs(Im(roots)) < 1e-8])
cat("fitted area reaches WT gm between ratios:", paste(round(2^sort(roots), 2), collapse = " and "), "\n")
cat("fitted area at 2:1:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = 1))), 0),
    " 3:1:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(3)))), 0),
    " 5:1:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(5)))), 0), "\n")

# Peak value with bootstrap CI (cluster bootstrap, same draws as before)
set.seed(1)
boot_peak_val <- replicate(5000, {
  idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(win)), win$ratio), function(i) sample(i, length(i), replace = TRUE)))
  d <- win[idx, ]
  cf <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = d))
  if (is.na(cf[3]) || cf[3] >= 0) NA_real_ else exp(cf[1] - cf[2]^2/(4*cf[3]))
})
cat("fitted peak area bootstrap median and 95% CI:",
    paste(round(quantile(boot_peak_val, c(.5, .025, .975), na.rm = TRUE)), collapse = "  "), "\n")

# Peak with 1000:1 excluded but 500:1 included, and vice versa
for (lab in c("excl1000", "excl500", "exclBoth")) {
  d <- switch(lab,
    excl1000 = subset(mix, ratio != 1000),
    excl500  = subset(mix, ratio != 500),
    exclBoth = subset(mix, ratio != 500 & ratio != 1000))
  cf2 <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = d))
  cat(lab, ": peak", round(2^(-cf2[2]/(2*cf2[3])), 2), " R2", round(summary(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = d))$r.squared, 3), "\n")
}
